description: Metadata definition for a bank application portfolio covering the three core entities Application, Project / Initiative, and Contract, together with the direct many-to-many relationships between them.

conventions.naming: snake_case for physical names; uppercase codes for enum values
conventions.identifiers: Stable, non-reusable business identifiers with entity-specific prefixes
conventions.deletion_policy: Referenced records should not be physically deleted. Use lifecycle or record status values and preserve relationship history.

tables.name: application
tables.description: Represents a software application, platform, or externally consumed application service managed as part of the bank's application portfolio.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Stable unique identifier for the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must match the pattern ^APP-[0-9]{6}$.
Must be unique and must never be reused.

attributes.name: application_name
attributes.description: Official business-recognized name of the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must not be blank or contain only whitespace.
Must be unique after trimming whitespace and ignoring case.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Concise explanation of the application's purpose and major business use.

quality_rules.rule: Recommended for all ACTIVE and RETIRING applications.

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Portfolio classification of the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.
ACTIVE requires production_date.
RETIRED or DECOMMISSIONED requires actual_retirement_date.

attributes.name: business_criticality
attributes.description: Business impact classification used for prioritization and resilience decisions.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: deployment_model
attributes.description: Primary deployment or consumption model of the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: production_date
attributes.description: Date on which the application first entered production service.

quality_rules.rule: Required when lifecycle_status is ACTIVE, RESTRICTED, RETIRING, RETIRED, or DECOMMISSIONED.
Must not be later than actual_retirement_date when that date is present.

attributes.name: planned_retirement_date
attributes.description: Current planned date for retiring the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must be later than production_date when both dates are present.
Required for RETIRING applications.

attributes.name: actual_retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the application stopped providing production service.

quality_rules.rule: Required when lifecycle_status is RETIRED or DECOMMISSIONED.
Must not be earlier than production_date.

attributes.name: target_disposition
attributes.description: Approved or proposed portfolio treatment for the application.

quality_rules.rule: When populated, must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Administrative state of the portfolio record.

quality_rules.rule: INACTIVE records must not be used for new relationships.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Authoritative source from which the record was loaded or synchronized.

quality_rules.rule: Must not be blank.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

quality_rules.rule: Must be a valid ISO 8601 UTC datetime.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent record update.

quality_rules.rule: Must be equal to or later than created_at.

table_quality_rules.rule: All required attributes must be populated.
application_id and normalized application_name must be unique.
ACTIVE and RETIRING records should be reviewed at least quarterly.

tables.name: project_initiative
tables.description: Represents a temporary project, programme, or strategic initiative that creates, changes, migrates, replaces, or retires applications and may establish or use contracts.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Stable unique identifier for the project or initiative.

quality_rules.rule: Must match the pattern ^PRJ-[0-9]{6}$.
Must be unique and must never be reused.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Official approved name of the project or initiative.

quality_rules.rule: Must not be blank or contain only whitespace.
Should be unique after trimming whitespace and ignoring case.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Summary of the project's purpose, scope, and expected outcomes.

quality_rules.rule: Required for APPROVED and IN_PROGRESS projects.

attributes.name: initiative_type
attributes.description: Classification of the project or initiative.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current delivery status of the project or initiative.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.
IN_PROGRESS requires actual_start_date.
COMPLETED requires actual_end_date.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Approved or forecast project start date.

quality_rules.rule: Required when status is APPROVED, PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, or COMPLETED.

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Approved or forecast project completion date.

quality_rules.rule: Must be equal to or later than planned_start_date.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which project delivery actually started.

quality_rules.rule: Required when status is IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the project was formally completed or closed.

quality_rules.rule: Required when status is COMPLETED.
Must be equal to or later than actual_start_date.

attributes.name: strategic_priority
attributes.description: Relative priority assigned by portfolio governance.

quality_rules.rule: When populated, must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved project budget in the specified currency.

quality_rules.rule: Must be greater than or equal to zero.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for monetary project attributes.

quality_rules.rule: Required when approved_budget_amount is populated.
Must be a valid ISO 4217 uppercase currency code.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Administrative state of the portfolio record.

quality_rules.rule: INACTIVE records must not be used for new relationships.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Authoritative source from which the record was loaded or synchronized.

quality_rules.rule: Must not be blank.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

quality_rules.rule: Must be a valid ISO 8601 UTC datetime.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent record update.

quality_rules.rule: Must be equal to or later than created_at.

table_quality_rules.rule: APPROVED, PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, and COMPLETED projects must have at least one application or contract relationship.
IN_PROGRESS projects should be reviewed at least monthly.

tables.name: contract
tables.description: Represents a legally or commercially binding agreement that licenses, supports, hosts, operates, implements, or otherwise enables one or more applications or projects.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Stable unique identifier for the contract.

quality_rules.rule: Must match the pattern ^CTR-[0-9]{6}$.
Must be unique and must never be reused.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Official procurement, legal, or ERP contract reference.

quality_rules.rule: Must not be blank.
Must be unique after trimming whitespace and ignoring case.

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the contract.

quality_rules.rule: Must not be blank or contain only whitespace.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Summary of the commercial scope and services covered.

quality_rules.rule: Recommended for ACTIVE contracts.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Primary commercial classification of the contract.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current legal or commercial status of the contract.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.
ACTIVE requires start_date and end_date.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the contract becomes effective.

quality_rules.rule: Required when status is ACTIVE, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, SUSPENDED, or TERMINATED.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Current contractual expiry or termination date.

quality_rules.rule: Must be later than start_date.
ACTIVE contracts with end_date within 180 days should be flagged for renewal review.

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: How the contract may be renewed at the end of its term.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of calendar days required to prevent renewal or terminate the contract.

quality_rules.rule: Must be greater than or equal to zero.
Required when renewal_type is AUTO_RENEWAL or MANUAL_RENEWAL.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Total committed contract value for the current contractual term.

quality_rules.rule: Must be greater than or equal to zero.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for monetary contract attributes.

quality_rules.rule: Required when total_contract_value is populated.
Must be a valid ISO 4217 uppercase currency code.

attributes.name: support_level
attributes.description: Highest support coverage committed under the contract.

quality_rules.rule: Recommended for support, maintenance, managed service, hosting, cloud, and outsourcing contracts.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Administrative state of the portfolio record.

quality_rules.rule: INACTIVE records must not be used for new relationships.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Authoritative source from which the record was loaded or synchronized.

quality_rules.rule: Must not be blank.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the record was created.

quality_rules.rule: Must be a valid ISO 8601 UTC datetime.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent record update.

quality_rules.rule: Must be equal to or later than created_at.

table_quality_rules.rule: ACTIVE contracts should cover at least one application or be linked to at least one active project.
ACTIVE contracts should be reviewed at least quarterly and before the notice deadline.

relationships.name: project_application
relationships.description: Records how a project or initiative creates, implements, enhances, upgrades, migrates, integrates, replaces, consolidates, retires, or otherwise impacts an application.

cardinality.description: A project may affect zero or many applications, and an application may be affected by zero or many projects over its lifecycle.

relationship_types.label: Creates
relationship_types.description: The project results in a new application portfolio record and production capability.

relationship_types.label: Implements
relationship_types.description: The project deploys or introduces an application that may already exist as a product or planned record.

relationship_types.label: Enhances
relationship_types.description: The project adds or improves application functionality without fundamentally replacing the application.

relationship_types.label: Upgrades
relationship_types.description: The project moves the application or a major component to a newer version or release.

relationship_types.label: Migrates
relationship_types.description: The project moves the application, workload, data, or hosting arrangement to a new platform or environment.

relationship_types.label: Integrates
relationship_types.description: The project creates or materially changes integration involving the application.

relationship_types.label: Replaces
relationship_types.description: The project introduces a successor and removes or plans to remove the application's business role.

relationship_types.label: Consolidates
relationship_types.description: The project combines functionality or usage from multiple applications into a smaller target set.

relationship_types.label: Retires
relationship_types.description: The project decommissions or removes the application from production use.

relationship_types.label: Impacts
relationship_types.description: The project affects the application, but a more specific relationship type is not yet known.

attributes.name: project_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the relationship record.

quality_rules.rule: Must match the pattern ^PRA-[0-9]{6}$.
Must be unique and must never be reused.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the related project or initiative.

quality_rules.rule: Must reference an existing project_initiative.project_id.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the affected application.

quality_rules.rule: Must reference an existing application.application_id.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Nature of the project's impact on the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined relationship type.

attributes.name: impact_description
attributes.description: Project-specific explanation of the expected or actual impact on the application.

quality_rules.rule: Required when relationship_type is IMPACTS.

attributes.name: planned_effective_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the relationship outcome becomes effective.

quality_rules.rule: Should fall within the project's planned or actual date range.

attributes.name: actual_effective_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the relationship outcome became effective.

quality_rules.rule: Required when relationship_status is COMPLETED.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Delivery status of this specific project-to-application impact.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: is_primary_change
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application is a primary project scope item rather than a secondary dependency.

quality_rules.rule: Must be true or false.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the relationship was created.

quality_rules.rule: Must be a valid ISO 8601 UTC datetime.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent relationship update.

quality_rules.rule: Must be equal to or later than created_at.

relationship_quality_rules.rule: The combination of project_id, application_id, and relationship_type must be unique.
RETIRES should normally target an ACTIVE, RESTRICTED, or RETIRING application.
CREATES or IMPLEMENTS should normally target a PROPOSED, PLANNED, or IN_DEVELOPMENT application.

relationships.name: application_contract
relationships.description: Records the direct and continuing commercial dependency between an application and a contract, independently of any project that originally established the contract.

cardinality.description: An application may be covered by zero or many contracts, and a contract may cover zero or many applications.

relationship_types.label: Licenses
relationship_types.description: The contract provides software, subscription, or usage rights required by the application.

relationship_types.label: Supports
relationship_types.description: The contract provides technical or functional support for the application.

relationship_types.label: Maintains
relationship_types.description: The contract provides corrective, preventive, adaptive, or enhancement maintenance.

relationship_types.label: Hosts
relationship_types.description: The contract provides infrastructure or a hosting environment for the application.

relationship_types.label: Operates
relationship_types.description: The contract provides day-to-day operational responsibility for the application.

relationship_types.label: Implements
relationship_types.description: The contract provides implementation or deployment services for the application.

relationship_types.label: Develops
relationship_types.description: The contract provides custom software development for the application.

relationship_types.label: Provides Cloud Services
relationship_types.description: The contract provides cloud platform, infrastructure, or consumption services used by the application.

relationship_types.label: Provides Managed Service
relationship_types.description: The contract provides an integrated managed service covering defined application responsibilities.

relationship_types.label: Covers
relationship_types.description: The contract covers the application, but a more specific commercial relationship is not yet known.

attributes.name: application_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the relationship record.

quality_rules.rule: Must match the pattern ^APC-[0-9]{6}$.
Must be unique and must never be reused.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the application covered by the contract.

quality_rules.rule: Must reference an existing application.application_id.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contract covering the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must reference an existing contract.contract_id.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Nature of the commercial coverage or service provided to the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined relationship type.

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contract begins covering the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must not be earlier than contract.start_date when contract.start_date is present.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contract stops covering the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must be later than coverage_start_date.
Must not be later than contract.end_date unless an approved extension exists.

attributes.name: application_cost_allocation
attributes.description: Amount of the contract value allocated to this application for the coverage period.

quality_rules.rule: Must be greater than or equal to zero.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the relevant contract value allocated to this application.

quality_rules.rule: Must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
For overlapping coverage periods, allocation percentages across applications for the same contract should not exceed 100.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for application_cost_allocation.

quality_rules.rule: Required when application_cost_allocation is populated.

attributes.name: is_primary_contract
attributes.description: Indicates that this is the primary contract for the specified coverage type.

quality_rules.rule: Only one active primary contract is allowed per application and relationship_type for overlapping dates.

attributes.name: is_critical_dependency
attributes.description: Indicates that expiry, termination, or failure of the contract would materially disrupt the application.

quality_rules.rule: Must be true or false.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current administrative status of the application-to-contract coverage.

quality_rules.rule: ACTIVE requires an ACTIVE or EXPIRING contract.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the relationship was created.

quality_rules.rule: Must be a valid ISO 8601 UTC datetime.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent relationship update.

quality_rules.rule: Must be equal to or later than created_at.

relationship_quality_rules.rule: The configured unique key must not be duplicated.
ACTIVE application-contract coverage must fall within the effective contract term.
Critical application-contract relationships should be reviewed before the contract notice deadline.

relationships.name: project_contract
relationships.description: Records how a project or initiative procures, establishes, uses, extends, renews, amends, replaces, terminates, or consumes services from a contract.

cardinality.description: A project may involve zero or many contracts, and a contract may support zero or many projects.

relationship_types.label: Procures
relationship_types.description: The project leads the sourcing and procurement of the contract.

relationship_types.label: Establishes
relationship_types.description: The contract is created or first activated as a direct outcome of the project.

relationship_types.label: Uses
relationship_types.description: The project consumes services or commercial rights from an existing contract.

relationship_types.label: Extends
relationship_types.description: The project expands the contract's term, value, scope, or covered services.

relationship_types.label: Renews
relationship_types.description: The project results in renewal of the contract for a new contractual term.

relationship_types.label: Amends
relationship_types.description: The project changes contractual clauses, deliverables, value, or obligations.

relationship_types.label: Replaces
relationship_types.description: The project introduces a successor contract that supersedes this contract.

relationship_types.label: Terminates
relationship_types.description: The project causes the contract to end before or at its planned expiry.

relationship_types.label: Consumes From Framework
relationship_types.description: The project places work, orders, or spend under an existing framework agreement.

attributes.name: project_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the relationship record.

quality_rules.rule: Must match the pattern ^PRC-[0-9]{6}$.
Must be unique and must never be reused.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the related project or initiative.

quality_rules.rule: Must reference an existing project_initiative.project_id.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the related contract.

quality_rules.rule: Must reference an existing contract.contract_id.

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Nature of the project's commercial relationship with the contract.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined relationship type.

attributes.name: project_scope_description
attributes.description: Explanation of the contract scope, deliverables, or services used by the project.

quality_rules.rule: Recommended when the contract also covers other projects or operational services.

attributes.name: project_cost_allocation
attributes.description: Amount of contract value allocated to this project.

quality_rules.rule: Must be greater than or equal to zero.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of relevant contract value allocated to this project.

quality_rules.rule: Must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
Allocation percentages across projects for the same contract and period should not exceed 100.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code for project_cost_allocation.

quality_rules.rule: Required when project_cost_allocation is populated.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this project-to-contract relationship becomes effective.

quality_rules.rule: Should fall within the project's and contract's effective date ranges.

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current administrative status of the project-to-contract relationship.

quality_rules.rule: Must contain exactly one defined enum value.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when the relationship was created.

quality_rules.rule: Must be a valid ISO 8601 UTC datetime.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent relationship update.

quality_rules.rule: Must be equal to or later than created_at.

relationship_quality_rules.rule: The combination of project_id, contract_id, and relationship_type must be unique.
ESTABLISHES or PROCURES should normally relate to a DRAFT, UNDER_REVIEW, APPROVED, or ACTIVE contract.
TERMINATES should normally relate to an ACTIVE, EXPIRING, or SUSPENDED contract.

cross_entity_rules.description: A project that ESTABLISHES or PROCURES a contract for an application should normally have both a project_contract relationship and a project_application relationship.

A direct application_contract relationship must be maintained even when the contract was originally established through a project, because the commercial dependency may continue after the project closes.
When a project REPLACES an application, the project should normally also CREATE or IMPLEMENT at least one successor application.
When a project RETIRES an application, all active application_contract relationships should be reviewed for termination, reassignment, or continued residual obligations.

An ACTIVE critical application with no active application_contract relationship should be reviewed to confirm whether it is internally developed and fully supported without external commercial dependency.
